_note: Curated overlay for the OmniAPI model catalog. Discovery (live /models) decides what is ONLINE; this file adds pricing, capabilities, status and routing. Prices are USD per 1M tokens unless the pricing object says otherwise. Sources: docs/research/2026-09-25-*.md and 2026-10-01-* Uncurated ids that are fixed snapshots (-YYYY-MM-DD, -0613 style) or moving aliases (-latest) are kept callable but hidden from listings.
_suggested_tiers_note:
providers.

.suggested_tiers (1.3-M4): what the first-run guide offers when the owner has connected only that provider. Candidates: the provider's text models with status current and no shutdown date, minus those that only work over the Responses API (tiers drive chat), those the catalog notes as legacy, and those with an announced retirement window. cheap = the candidate with the lowest output price (input price breaks a tie); strong = the one with the highest output price (each vendor prices its flagship highest); standard = the newest model of the vendor's middle line (OpenAI Sol, Anthropic Opus, Google Flash), priced between the two; DeepSeek has only two models and the owner chose Flash for standard as well. Prices are this file's own. Checked by tests/unit/test_settings_m4.py. OpenRouter has none: its models are listed live and this file holds no prices for them. Reviewed by the owner on 2026-10-04 (decision record D51).
